attributes.name: SDLC: Items with no activity in 14 days

esqlQuery.esql: FROM github-intel-project-items | WHERE entity.type == "ISSUE" | EVAL age_days = DATE_DIFF("days", github.updated_at, NOW()) | WHERE age_days > 14 | KEEP entity.number, payload.content.title, age_days | LIMIT 10

attributes.description: Fires when a project item (issue) has had no activity for more than 14 days.

name: SDLC: Items with no activity in 14 days
